// diagnostic E0608

Jet.UnknownInlineModuleFunction

Function not defined in inline code module

What

Function not defined in inline code module

Why

A call into an inline code module can only reach functions that module defines

Fix

Define the referenced function in the inline code module.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.UnknownInlineModuleFunction: Tests/UI/module_inline_unknown_fn.stderr.

Error: Jet.UnknownInlineModuleFunction: `multiply` is not defined in module `math`
  --> Tests/UI/module_inline_unknown_fn.jet:5:19
    |
  5 | run: fn() { print(math.multiply(2, 3)) }
    |                   ^^^^
 Why: Check the module body for the function you're calling
 Fix: Make sure the function name is spelled correctly
More: jet-lang.dev/e/Jet.UnknownInlineModuleFunction
